summary: Frontend code review of 8 critical bug fixes in Appointments module. UI testing blocked by authentication issues (backend API returning 520 status). Code review confirms implementations are correct.

critical.issue: Backend returns 520 status (Cloudflare error) - authentication cannot complete. This blocks all UI testing.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot login to app - backend returns 520 status. Unable to verify UI fixes in running application.

bug_1_therapist_display.details: Handles both single staff_name and staff_names array. Shows 'Therapist A, Therapist B' for multi-therapist cases.

bug_2_client_name_detail_page.details: Client name displays with data-testid='detail-client-name'. Uses displayClientName fallback to 'Unknown Client'.

bug_3_quick_actions_visible.details: Quick actions section ALWAYS visible. View button (chevron-forward) shows even when showActions=false. Detail page has data-testid='detail-actions-section' with status-specific actions for active appointments and empty state message for completed/cancelled.

bug_4_multi_day_preferred_time.details: Shows 'Preferred Time:' label with properly formatted time (e.g., '10:00 AM'). Has preferredTimeText style for visibility.

bug_5_gender_matching_conflict.details: Gender conflict detection implemented. Shows warning banner when female client has no female therapists. genderFilteredTherapistOptions filters therapists based on client gender.

bug_6_alternative_slots_selection.details: Alternative slots are selectable with visual indication. Uses data-testid='alternative-slot-{n}'. Shows staff name, room, time, and score percentage.

bug_7_conflict_modal_styled.details: Styled Modal component replaces raw Alert. Shows warning icon, title, conflict messages with icons, help text, and 'Got it' button. Full styling defined in lines 2152-2220.

bug_8_therapist_dropdown_filter.details: therapistOptions filters by staff_type === 'therapist' ONLY. Strict filter prevents other roles like clinic_admin, receptionist, doctor from appearing.
